title: The Opening Match of the Tournament
next_chapter_hook: At the highest point of the stands, a black-clad figure slowly withdrew his gaze, fingers tapping lightly on the armrest, a half-smile on his lips—"Interesting."

text.content:
Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, morning mist still undispersed, the clamor of thousands of disciples had already pierced the clouds. Today marked the first day of the Sect Competition, sunlight filtering through the thin haze to cast upon the Blue Stone Arena, creating mottled shadows. Disciples from each faction took their seats in order, the air thick with a mingling tension and excitement.

Chen Ji stood at the very edge of the crowd, his gray servant's garb glaringly conspicuous among the numerous splendid robes. Several passing disciples deliberately bumped his shoulder, sneering: "Oh, thetrash is here to watch the tournament? Aren't you afraid of being crushed by the residual true qi?"

Chen Ji's steps never paused, the corner of his lips slightly raised—he had taken note. Waiting for the right moment.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Han Lie was right—today really is about "rendering oneself powerless"... only, it's about crippling someone else's cultivation.

text.content:
Above the high platform, Su Qingyao wore a cyan-green robe, her brows and eyes like frost. Her gaze swept across the crowd, pausing on Chen Ji for half a breath—why did thistrash servant always give her an inexplicable feeling?

"The drawing begins." The Law Enforcement Elder's voice rang like a bell.

Before the bronze box, heads pressed together, draw sticks flying. When Chen Ji reached into the box, a snide voice came from behind: "Oh, the Chentrash is here to draw too? Don't tell me you'll be matched against me? That would truly be heaven's eye-opening, letting me "guide" you through a few moves!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned around, facing the familiar face—Sun Hao, an Inner Disciple, the one who humiliated him in public three months ago.
(Calmly said) Sun Senior Brother, what luck—you've drawn the chance to "guide" me. Don't worry, I'll make you... remember this moment forever.

text.content:
Sun Hao froze for a moment, then burst into laughter: "Hahaha! Thetrash even knows how to talk big now! Let's see how you make me remember fore—"

Before he finished, the Law Enforcement Elder had already unfolded the draw stick, announcing loudly: "Third match of the first round, Chen Ji versus Sun Hao!"

The entire crowd erupted in laughter, someone even whistling.

dialogue.content: (Stepping onto the arena platform, expression unchanged) Sun Senior Brother, if you please.

choice.prompt: Facing Sun Hao's contempt, how do you plan to handle this seemingly assured victory?

choices.text: Crushing swift victory, single strike to defeat the enemy
choices.description: Give Sun Hao no chance to react, defeat him with a single punch, crushing all mockers with absolute strength
choices.visible_cost: Reveal a portion of his true strength
choices.visible_reward: The entire arena shocked, Sun Hao's face utterly disgraced

text.content: Sun Hao snorted, forming hand seals as true qi surged within him—he couldn't even be bothered to attack first, wanting Chen Ji to strike first so he could publicly humiliate him.

choices.text: Hide one's true abilities, acting weak to later dominate
choices.description: Deliberately appear weak, lure Sun Hao into overconfidence, then counterattack at the crucial moment, making him lose without understanding why
choices.visible_cost: Might take a few hits first
choices.visible_reward: Humiliating Sun Hao at his most complacent creates a greater contrast
choices.risk_hint: The audience might curse you astrash first

text.content: Seeing Chen Ji silent, Sun Hao thought he'd scared the other speechless,得意的勾了勾手指: "怎么？腿软了？trash就是trash，连上台的勇气都没有——哦等等，你不是上来了吗？抱歉，我忘了。"

Chen Ji did not respond to Sun Hao's provocation, merely tilting his body slightly, assuming what appeared to be a clumsy opening stance.

"trash就是trash，这姿势都能摔着自己。" Sun Hao shook his head, channeling true qi as he unleashed a "Stone-Cracking Palm" aimed at Chen Ji—he couldn't even be bothered to use a proper martial technique, just wanting to slap the other off the arena platform with one blow.

Palm wind howled, the audience below already preparing their ridicule.

Chen Ji moved.

Not dodging, not blocking—he stepped forward into the palm wind.

That seemingly clumsy figure suddenly erupted with astonishing speed, his right fist like a venomous serpent striking precisely at the inner side of Sun Hao's wrist.

"Crack!"

The bone-breaking sound was crisp and pleasing. Sun Hao's "Stone-Cracking Palm" veered off course, the recoil force sending him stumbling backward, his eyes filled with disbelief.

dialogue.content: (Beautiful eyes slightly narrowing) This punch... he was hiding his strength?

text.content:
Without giving Sun Hao time to react, Chen Ji pressed forward.

"You, you—"

Sun Hao tried to speak, but before his mouth could form words, a heavy fist was already crashing toward his face.

"Thud!"

A dull striking sound echoed across the martial arena. Sun Hao fell flat on his back, nose bleeding profusely, stars spinning before his eyes. He wanted to struggle to his feet, but found his entire body felt as if crushed by a massive boulder—even lifting his hand was impossible.

dialogue.content: (Gazing down from above at Sun Hao) Sun Senior Brother, is this the "guidance" you spoke of?

choice.prompt: Sun Hao has been knocked down, the crowd below in an uproar. What will you do?

choices.text: Harsh mockery, stepping on his face and verbally crushing him
choices.description: Use the most sarcastic words to publicly humiliate Sun Hao, making everyone remember this moment forever
choices.visible_reward: The entire arena shocked, thetrash persona completely shattered
choices.risk_hint: May provoke jealousy from certain people

dialogue.content: (Crouching down, voice not loud but sufficient for the entire crowd to hear) Stone-Cracking Palm? You cracked your own bones, didn't you? Sun Senior Brother, I remember you saying last time that you'd "rub my face into the ground"? Mm, this position actually suits you quite well.

choices.text: Casually indifferent, walking away with pride
choices.description: No need for many words, turn and leave—let actions prove that strength speaks louder than words
choices.visible_reward: Leave suspense, letting everyone speculate about your true strength
choices.risk_hint: The audience might think you won by luck

dialogue.content: (Rising, brushing dust off knees that weren't even dusty) Heard you were looking forward to this match? Mm, I was looking forward to it too... looking forward to the next time you can still say the word "trash."

text.content:
The entire arena fell deathly silent.

Thousands of gazes fell upon Chen Ji simultaneously—shock, confusion, disbelief... The crowd that had just been ridiculing the "trash," now seemed to have their throats gripped shut.

Sun Hao lay on the ground, eyes reddened, lips trembling yet unable to utter a single word—not from injury, but from humiliation.

dialogue.content: (Turning to the Law Enforcement Elder, saluting with hands clasped) Elder, victory has been decided. May I trouble you to announce it?
(In the shadows of the high platform, a black-clad figure narrowed his eyes slightly, fingers tapping lightly on the armrest) ...Interesting.

text.content:
The Law Enforcement Elder froze for a moment before reacting: "Third match of the first round, Chen Ji... wins!"

The voice echoed through the martial arena, yet like a stone dropped into still water, it couldn't stir even a ripple. Everyone was still too shocked to回过神.

Chen Ji had already descended from the arena, his gray servant's garb disappearing into the crowd. Sunlight fell upon his shoulders, casting a solitary yet razor-sharp silhouette.

From the corner, Su Qingyao withdrew her gaze, brow slightly furrowed. She looked down at the draw tube in her hand, fingertips unconsciously tracing the edge of the bamboo slips.

"Chen Ji..." she murmured, "how many secrets are you still hiding?"

On the other side of the martial arena, at the highest point of the stands, Ling Yuan's black-clad figure slowly withdrew his gaze from within the morning mist. A meaningful smile curved the corner of his lips, as if he had spotted something intriguing.

The chess game has begun, and the true博弈... has just started.
